name: cz.applifting.firebasewrappersdk.FirebaseCloudMessagingService
description: Applifting Firebase Wrapper handles incoming Firebase notification messages in this Service and displays their title and text as a system notification. The wrapper also exposes Firebase topic subscribe and unsubscribe support to the app.
disableEffect: Notifications routed through this Service will stop appearing, and messages for its Firebase topics will no longer be processed here.
